Package dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.profile

Record Class RecentMatch

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.profile.RecentMatch
Record Components:
matchId - identifies the match; stable across reads of the same history
endedAt - when the player's match ended, in epoch milliseconds
teamMode - whether the match was played in teams rather than solo
arena - the arena name, or null when unknown
gameType - the game type name, or null when unknown
outcome - how the match ended for the player
placement - solo or team placement, or 0 while it is unknown
kills - kills credited in the match
assists - assists credited in the match
damageDealt - damage dealt in the match
survivalSeconds - seconds survived in the match, or -1 when unknown
public record RecentMatch(@Nullable String matchId, long endedAt, boolean teamMode, @Nullable String arena, @Nullable String gameType, @NotNull RecentMatch.MatchOutcome outcome, int placement, int kills, int assists, double damageDealt, long survivalSeconds) extends Record
One finished match in a player's recent match history, as Zentrix stores it.

A profile keeps its most recent matches, newest first. A match's placement can be decided after the player's own part in it ended - a team still fighting, or a player who may rejoin - so an entry read early may show no placement yet and a settled one later.

Since:
1.8.0
